name: First Holy Communion
overview: First Holy Communion reflects Jesus' institution of the Lord's Supper, where He took bread, blessed it, and declared it His body given for us, commanding believers to partake in remembrance of Him. This sacred act points to Christ's sacrificial suffering for our sins, as prophesied in Isaiah, and invites all, including children, to come to Him, affirming their place in the kingdom of heaven. The practice centers on faith in Christ's atoning work and the grace extended to believers through His broken body.
